remarks: Highest, best and final by Wednesday June 5, 2024 5:00 pm. Will notify on Thursday pm. Single Family with strong bones. Current owner has been there for 38 years. Roof is about 10 years old. Interior not much to do. But, you can remodel to your taste. Will not qualify for an FHA Loan.  HOME BEING Sold "AS IS". Subject to Probate Court and Appeal period
